item.title: U.S. single-family home sales fall 1.7% in December
item.description: U.S. new single-family home sales fell 1.7% in December 2023, while inventory levels declined, potentially aiding new housing starts. Median prices rose 4.2%.

item.title: EPA to weaken air toxic standards for coal plants
item.description: Trump administration moves to roll back Mercury and Air Toxics Standards for coal plants, citing energy demand, as health groups warn of risks.

item.title: Fed well positioned to study AI’s economic impact, Daly says
item.description: San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly says interest rate policy is well positioned as officials weigh AI’s impact on productivity and inflation.

item.title: U.S. investors pull $75B from stock market, eye overseas investments
item.description: U.S. investors pulled $75B from US stocks in six months as S&P 500 gains fade and emerging markets, Europe and Japan post stronger returns.

item.title: U.S. economic growth slowed sharply to 1.4% in Q4
item.description: U.S. economy cooled to 1.4% growth in late 2025 as tariffs and a government shutdown weighed on GDP, while inflation rose and recession fears mounted.

item.title: Just Sold: IGO Legacy wraps up string of hotel sales
item.description: After more than 35 years in the hospitality industry, Duluth-based IGO Legacy Hotel Group has closed its management business and handed new owners the keys to the last of a dozen properties in its final portfolio.

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court strikes down Trump’s global tariffs
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled 6-3 that Trump exceeded his authority under IEEPA to impose sweeping tariffs, curbing presidential trade powers.

item.title: Q&A: Dan Ruehl on Enclave’s new investment fund
item.description: Enclave Cos. launches its Real IncomePlus Fund, seeded with $200M in apartments, targeting multifamily and industrial buys.

item.title: Cottage Grove advances apartment project on challenging site
item.description: Cottage Grove approves a $45.6M, 186-unit market-rate apartment project by Yellow Tree Development after granting a 10-year tax abatement for the site.

item.title: Interview: Paul Donovan, COO, Forte Real Estate Services
item.description: Paul Donovan, COO of Forte Real Estate Services talks about his job duties with Forte, his experience in site selection and transaction management, and the outlook for the office-industrial market.
